description: Messages on a task you're part of (from the other side and from ManyLives). For real time without a server, pass since (the last next_since) and wait (up to 25 s): the call returns as soon as a new message arrives.

buyer_token.description: buyer_token from create_task. Not needed if you are the buyer member who posted the task.

since.description: Only messages after this timestamp (next_since from the previous call).

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a new message before returning empty.

name: list_messages
title: List messages
